greeting: BEHOLD! The SEA SERPENT of the Seven Tides!
Marina's the name, charming's the game!
Step right up! Witness the IMPOSSIBLE!
You! Yes, you! Dare you meet my serpent?
Back for more? The serpent remembers you!
Welcome to the pier! Where magic meets the SEA!
The ocean holds mysteries! I bring them to YOU!
Prepare to be AMAZED! Or at least... entertained!
dialog.performance_start: From the briny depths... I summon... NEPTUNE! My magnificent sea snake!
dialog.crowd_work: Don't be shy! He only bites on Tuesdays! Today is... not Tuesday! Probably!
dialog.show_climax: And NOW! Watch as Neptune rises! Transfixed by my coastal melody!
dialog.tips_request: If the serpent pleased you... the hat accepts offerings! Coin! Shells! Fish!
dialog.snake_truth: Between us? Neptune's a common sea snake. Completely harmless. But SHH! I have a REPUTATION!
dialog.backstory: Learned from Mire masters! Adapted for salt water! It's all about the FLUTE!
rumor: The real sea serpents are DEEP. Bigger than ships. Smarter than us.
Mire's snakecharmer taught me everything! Well, the basics!
Tide crowds are GENEROUS! Except when it rains!
Aetherreach has cloud serpents. Too high for me!
farewell: Safe travels! Watch for REAL sea serpents!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning warm-up! Neptune needs coffee! So do I!

party_reactions.kade: Another snakecharmer? This one smells like fish.
party_reactions.nix7: Snake species: sea snake. Venom: mild. Showmanship: excessive.
party_reactions.twist: SNAKE! Can I pet it?! Is it SCALY?!
party_reactions.korr: Entertainment brings joy. Even simple tricks.
party_reactions.renna: The flute technique is... adequate. The patter is better.
party_reactions.suresh: To bring wonder to others is its own magic.
party_reactions.sova: I've seen real sea serpents. This is cuter.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of camp entertainers. Kept morale up.
party_reactions.ashka: Sea snakes are cold. Prefer warmth.
party_reactions.senna: Distraction for the crowd. Useful technique.
party_reactions.callum: The snake is... very wiggly! Cool!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Prepare to be CHARMED!
relationship_dialog.friend: My fan! Front row seat! Always!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! My patron! Here - Neptune's shed skin! Lucky charm!
